title: Packet glint color literal duplicated across the Triangle and Circle branches
evidence:
line 1083: rl.DrawCircleV({pos.x - r * 0.16, pos.y - r * 0.34}, r * 0.20, rl.Color{250, 246, 238, body.a})
line 1093: rl.DrawCircleV({pos.x - r * 0.34, pos.y - r * 0.34}, r * 0.22, rl.Color{250, 246, 238, body.a})
detail: The warm-cream glint hex {250,246,238} appears twice as a magic literal; a future glint tone tweak must find both copies. Project precedent is named render-side constants (CASING_OVERHANG).
